rule: route 1b (D1): one group per plan target (backlog-refactor-plan targets; the 3 model-evaluation-queue files are one target, BRF-T7-MEQ). Readiness may differ inside a group because every former handoff becomes a marked track: its body takes the member row Deps as its gate marker and the tracks it already had keep theirs. A ref to a handoff of the same group becomes `<ROW>#<track>` refs (index_state BRF-T7-1 prerequisite); a Deps cell ref to a member becomes the kept row. Proof: the real index_state derive_readiness (per-track gates, track refs, task states) over the virtual graph, cumulatively in list order: every unit with dispatchable work (a former handoff, or a track it already had) keeps readiness and blockers (mapped through the redirects).

folds.procedure: anchor: keep its preamble (H1 and header lines up to the first `##` heading) untracked; from that heading to its first existing `## Track:` goes under `## Track: <anchor stem>` (headings demoted two levels outside fences). Each other member: the same for its whole body before its first `## Track:`, appended as `## Track: <member stem>`. Every `## Track:` a member or the anchor already carries is LIFTED verbatim (never demoted) after its owner, with the marker below. Stubs go to completed/ as in route 1a.
